disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 通读了全部源码、编译产物、文档与测试，检索了密钥、口令、令牌、私钥等敏感信息模式，未发现任何硬编码凭据，也没有读取凭据配置、SSH 私钥或云厂商凭据的代码路径。
checked_items.en: Read through all source code, build artifacts, documentation, and tests; searched for sensitive information patterns such as secrets, passwords, tokens, and private keys. No hardcoded credentials were found, nor any code paths that read credential configurations, SSH private keys, or cloud provider credentials.

checked_items.zh: hub 检查模块仅请求公开目录数据，不读取本地认证信息；其失败处理明确标注不暴露认证细节，未发现凭据枚举或钱包资产访问行为。
checked_items.en: The hub check module only requests public directory data and does not read local authentication information; its failure handling explicitly marks that it does not expose authentication details. No credential enumeration or wallet asset access behavior was found.

evidence.zh: 核查凭据读取面：全树未检出读取凭据配置、SSH 私钥、云凭据等敏感路径的代码；测试用例中的 secret 字样仅是验证路径越界拦截的夹具，非真实读取。
evidence.en: Checked the credential reading surface: no code reading sensitive paths such as credential configurations, SSH private keys, or cloud credentials was detected across the entire tree; the "secret" strings in test cases are merely fixtures for verifying path traversal interception, not actual reads.

checked_items.zh: 审查了注册工具的描述文本与全部参数说明：描述仅说明检查功能与只读边界，不含指令覆写、系统消息伪装、权限绕过或诱导安装的措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the descriptions of registered tools and all parameter descriptions: the description only explains the check functionality and read-only boundaries, without any wording for instruction override, system message spoofing, privilege bypass, or induced installation.

checked_items.zh: 全树（含嵌套目录）检索了代理指令文件、伪装系统提示、隐藏文本与远程指令加载写法，均未发现；仓库内提及的 SKILL.md 只是检查对象，不是本插件自带的指令文件。
checked_items.en: Searched the entire tree (including nested directories) for proxy instruction files, disguised system prompts, hidden text, and remote instruction loading patterns; none were found. The SKILL.md mentioned in the repository is merely an inspection target, not an instruction file bundled with this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 未发现向系统提示注入内容或改写工具描述的代码路径；工具输出为 JSON 文本，内容来自固定检查项模板与被检仓库的标识字符串。
checked_items.en: No code path was found that injects content into system prompts or rewrites tool descriptions; the tool output is JSON text, whose content comes from fixed check-item templates and the identifier strings of the inspected repository.

evidence.zh: 工具描述逐句审查，内容为诊断功能的客观说明（原文写明 Read-only: never modifies or builds the checked repository），无注入措辞；参数仅 action/path/strict 三个，无诱导填写凭据等字段。
evidence.en: Reviewed the tool description sentence by sentence; the content is an objective description of the diagnostic functionality (the original text states "Read-only: never modifies or builds the checked repository"), with no injection wording; the parameters are only action/path/strict, with no fields inducing credential input.

evidence.zh: 全树未发现诱导执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；README 中的安装命令为正常使用文档，不构成对模型的安装诱导。
evidence.en: No wording was found across the tree that induces installation, rewriting configurations, or relaxing permissions; the installation command in the README is normal usage documentation and does not constitute installation inducement to models.

checked_items.zh: 逐文件检查了全部源码与编译产物（src/ 与 lib/ 各模块及声明文件），未发现脚本求值、动态函数构造、远程载荷下载执行等动态执行写法；子进程调用仅出现在 hub 检查模块。
checked_items.en: Checked all source code and build artifacts file by file (each module in src/ and lib/ and declaration files); no dynamic execution patterns such as script evaluation, dynamic function construction, or remote payload download-and-execute were found; subprocess calls appear only in the hub check module.

checked_items.zh: 子进程执行命中已逐条裁决（规则 DSH-X03 / DG-R3-55，共 4 处：源码与编译产物的导入语句各 1 处、中英文 README 各 1 处）：实际仅以固定参数列表调用系统命令 gh 抓取公开 hub 目录、git 读取被检仓库远端地址，不使用 shell、不把用户输入拼成命令，均带超时与输出上限，属于工具声明的诊断功能，排除恶意用途。
checked_items.en: The subprocess execution hits have been adjudicated one by one (rules DSH-X03 / DG-R3-55, 4 in total: 1 each in the import statements of source and build artifacts, 1 each in the Chinese and English READMEs): in practice, only the system command gh is called with a fixed parameter list to fetch the public hub directory, and git to read the remote address of the inspected repository. No shell is used, and user input is not concatenated into commands; all calls have timeouts and output limits, belonging to the diagnostic functionality declared by the tool; malicious use is excluded.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置全文仅为普通条目插入，不含可执行脚本标记；包脚本只有类型检查、测试、构建与打包前构建，无安装期执行钩子；树内无钩子管理器、CI 工作流、容器配置等执行载体。
checked_items.en: The patch config is entirely plain entry insertion, containing no executable script markers; package scripts include only type checking, testing, building, and pre-package build, with no install-time execution hooks; no hook managers, CI workflows, container configs, or other execution carriers exist in the tree.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 全文仅含一条工具条目插入（id/name 两字段），未发现可执行脚本标记（!!js 等），不存在配置即执行面。
evidence.en: The patch config cordis.patch.yml contains only a single tool entry insertion (id/name fields), with no executable script markers (such as !!js) found; there is no configuration-as-execution surface.

evidence.zh: 全树未引用动态包工具（cordis_define/cordis_run），也没有把代码送入沙箱执行的自改写法。
evidence.en: The entire tree does not reference dynamic package tools (cordis_define/cordis_run), nor any self-modifying patterns that send code into a sandbox for execution.

evidence.zh: 包清单无安装/准备期执行钩子；构建脚本只做编译；树内无 husky、工作流、devcontainer 等树内执行载体。
evidence.en: The package manifest has no install/prepare-time execution hooks; build scripts only compile; no husky, workflows, devcontainer, or other in-tree execution carriers exist.

evidence.zh: 清单未声明浏览器端模块（dsh.client），客户端自动加载场景不适用。
evidence.en: The manifest does not declare a browser-side module (dsh.client), so the client auto-load scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 枚举了全部网络与命令行外发通道：唯一外联是 hub 检查模块经 gh 命令抓取公开目录 JSON（固定 URL），带 15 秒超时与 8MB 输出上限，全部失败场景静默降级为跳过。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all network and command-line exfiltration channels: the only outbound connection is the hub check module invoking the gh command to fetch public directory JSON (fixed URL), with a 15-second timeout and 8MB output cap; all failure scenarios silently degrade to skipping.

checked_items.zh: 未发现编码变换后外发、带外通道、端点劫持、命令行下载外发等模式；未发现读取敏感数据后联网发送的组合。
checked_items.en: No patterns of encoded-transform exfiltration, out-of-band channels, endpoint hijacking, command-line download exfiltration, or combined reading of sensitive data followed by network transmission were found.

evidence.zh: 外联通道核查：唯一外联目标为公开 GitHub 目录，参数固定、无凭据随行；未检出凭据读取与网络发送的组合，也不存在裸 IP、隧道或临时上传等带外通道。
evidence.en: Outbound channel check: the only outbound target is a public GitHub directory; parameters are fixed, with no credentials attached; no combination of credential reading and network sending was detected, and no out-of-band channels such as raw IPs, tunnels, or temporary uploads exist.

checked_items.zh: 依赖面核对：运行时仅声明官方作用域包（cordis 运行时、工具定义、不变量三件套）为对等依赖，开发依赖为官方 TypeScript、测试框架与类型声明；锁定文件顶层依赖均为官方包，未发现仿冒包名或浮动 git 引用。
checked_items.en: Dependency surface check: only official scoped packages (the Cordis runtime, tool definition, and invariant trio) are declared as peer dependencies at runtime; development dependencies are official TypeScript, testing frameworks, and type declarations; the lockfile's top-level dependencies are all official packages, with no spoofed package names or floating git references found.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置核对：不触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，不含禁用标记、环境变量降权或注入/拦截改写。
checked_items.en: Patch config check: it does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; it contains no disable flags, environment variable downgrades, or injection/interception rewrites.

checked_items.zh: 未发现对安全事件的高优先级监听或审批链截断写法，也未发现给安全插件追加必需服务致其挂起的改写。
checked_items.en: No high-priority listeners on security events or approval-chain truncation patterns were found, nor rewrites that append required services to security plugins causing them to hang.

checked_items.zh: 本仓为首次审计，无上一版本可比；作者为 omdsh-dev 组织账号，无异常身份信号。
checked_items.en: This repository is audited for the first time, with no previous version to compare; the author is the omdsh-dev organization account, with no abnormal identity signals.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入一条工具条目，未触碰任何安全配置行，无禁用或降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config inserts only one tool entry, does not touch any security configuration lines, and has no disable or downgrade patterns.

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批、工具执行前等安全事件的高优先级监听，无截断审批链的写法。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners on security events such as approval or pre-tool-execution were found, and no patterns truncating the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无版本基线，无法比较清单声明突变，不适用。
evidence.en: First audit without a version baseline; comparing manifest declaration mutations is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置无注入/拦截字段，不存在通过改写配置使安全插件挂起的滥用面。
evidence.en: The patch config has no injection/interception fields; there is no abuse surface to hang security plugins by rewriting configurations.

checked_items.zh: 未发现启动网络服务或监听端口的代码，本插件不暴露本机 RPC 面。
checked_items.en: No code that starts a network service or listens on a port was found; this plugin does not expose a local RPC surface.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱验证未执行（本轮无动态观测产物），运行时行为仅能静态评估；静态面未发现异常运行时行为。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not executed (no dynamic observation artifacts this round); runtime behavior can only be assessed statically; no anomalous runtime behavior was found on the static surface.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动任何网络服务或监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 场景不适用；该场景属宿主生态固有风险，与本插件无关。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start any network service or listen on any port, so the local unauthenticated RPC scenario is not applicable; that scenario is an inherent risk of the host ecosystem and unrelated to this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核对通过：dsh 声明与挂载配置合法，名称无仿冒，作者身份无异常信号。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: the dsh declaration and patch config are valid, the name has no spoofing, and the author identity shows no abnormal signals.

summary.zh: 静态扫描通过：未检出动态执行、凭据、注入等危险模式；子进程调用命中已裁决为良性。
summary.en: Static scan passed: no dangerous patterns such as dynamic execution, credentials, or injection were detected; subprocess call hits have been adjudicated as benign.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无敏感路径读取；唯一外联为公开目录抓取。
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: no install hooks, obfuscated payloads, or sensitive path reads; the only outbound connection is fetching the public directory.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：工具描述与参数无注入措辞，声明能力与代码实测一致。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: tool description and parameters have no injection wording, and the declared capabilities match the code as actually tested.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态观测产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic observation artifacts).

limits.zh:
未做动态沙箱验证（L4 无观测产物），运行时行为仅静态评估。

清单协议未显式声明能力项，本报告的 network/shell/fs/modelFacing 能力为按代码实测推断，能力对账按此口径判定。

dsh 兼容版本取自 README 声明（0.1.1-rc.1），包清单未声明 engines.dsh，未经实测。

首次审计无版本基线，版本对比项均按无基线处理。

锁定文件仅核对顶层依赖与解析来源，未逐行通读（开发期依赖，不参与运行）。

远端目录数据与被检仓库的标识字符串均按不可信数据处理，仅用于匹配与回显，未发现注入面。
limits.en:
No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (L4 has no observation artifacts); runtime behavior is assessed statically only.

The manifest protocol does not explicitly declare capability items; this report's network/shell/fs/modelFacing capabilities are inferred from code as actually tested, and capability reconciliation is judged on this basis.

The dsh compatible version is taken from the README declaration (0.1.1-rc.1); the package manifest does not declare engines.dsh and this was not actually tested.

First audit with no version baseline; all version comparison items are treated as no baseline.

The lockfile was checked only for top-level dependencies and resolution sources, not read line by line (development-time dependencies, not involved in runtime).

Remote directory data and identifier strings of the inspected repository are both treated as untrusted data, used only for matching and echo; no injection surface was found.
